title: Michael is put in a machine like a shower stall

tellings.quote: I got into this machine. It's like a shower stall.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that in 1977, at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he was put into a machine that was "like a shower stall." He tells it himself, as part of his account of being abducted by beings while serving there, in a conversation where he reunites with others who say the same happened to them.
